intro.title: useMemo for Expensive Computation
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React app that calculates the factorial of a number. You will learn how to use the useMemo hook to optimize expensive computations by caching their results. The main technologies involved are React, JavaScript, and the useMemo hook from React's Hooks API. This will help you understand how to prevent unnecessary recalculations and improve your app's performance in a beginner-friendly way.
intro.usecase: In real-world applications, useMemo is essential for optimizing performance in data-heavy UI components. For example, a financial dashboard might need to compute complex metrics like portfolio returns or risk scores from large datasets every time the user interacts with filters. Without useMemo, these expensive calculations would re-run on every render, causing noticeable lag when adjusting date ranges or asset categories. By memoizing the computed values, the dashboard remains responsive, providing a smooth user experience while ensuring data accuracy.
